unseen_basis: The two records and their source URLs were selected after the policy lock. Prior project manifests, protocols, source lists and reports contained neither NARA 302035 nor DOJ 005-aba-crd-part5 or the corresponding letters. The project development pages were Wells-Barnett and Robinson. The two new originals were visually annotated before any system OCR on either. This is project-level holdout, with two independent physical records.
annotation: Manual, from full page pixels and a closer view of both receipt impressions. Original raster pixel coordinates, origin at upper left, half-open axis-aligned word bounds. Multiple legitimate impressions of the same date are separately identified before scoring. Either must independently pass both geometric thresholds.

nixon.description: Richard Nixon's letter of resignation to the Secretary of State, August 9, 1974
nixon.layout: Color scan with centered full-month issue date and letterhead, sparse typescript and a handwritten time without a separate date.
